# 上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司 (TreeHouse Tech / Shanghai Shuxia Xiaowu Network Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Official website of an independent app studio in Shanghai, with four apps: TimeTrails, Memoria, TraceApp and Harbor. Website: https://sxxw.site · English home: https://sxxw.site/en/ · Support email: house@sxxw.site. Platforms, distribution, data handling and translated content differ by product; see the product pages below.

上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司的官网是 https://sxxw.site/ 。旗下「足迹-时光轨迹」（TimeTrails）是一款 GPS 足迹记录 App：记录每日轨迹，将日常出行积累为可回顾的一生轨迹。官方产品页：https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/ 。

TreeHouse Tech（树下小屋）是本网站使用的工作室名称。上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司提供本网站中的足迹-时光轨迹、纪念日、出行轨迹 TraceApp 与 Harbor；Harbor 当前通过 TestFlight 提供测试版。

TreeHouse Tech is the studio name used on this website by 上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司. This is the official site for its TimeTrails, Memoria, TraceApp and Harbor apps, with official product details, download or beta links, and support.

Data handling is product-specific. TimeTrails and Memoria for iOS keep personal records on-device by default, with optional private iCloud backup or sync. Memoria for HarmonyOS is local-only. Harbor connects directly to the user's configured server; its connection and watch-history data are local, it has no cross-device cloud sync, and Apple handles TestFlight testing data separately. See each product's privacy policy for the full scope.

## 足迹-时光轨迹 / TimeTrails

TimeTrails is a privacy-first GPS route tracker for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Daily GPS tracking records daily routes and builds a lifetime travel map from the routes the user records. Route history can be reviewed by day, on a map or on Trail Planet; route data stays on the device by default, with optional private iCloud backup.

- Official name: 足迹-时光轨迹. English name: TimeTrails. “每日轨迹” describes its daily route history; “一生轨迹” describes the long-term collection of the user's recorded routes, rather than a separate product.
- Daily use: automatically record walking, running, cycling, hiking, driving and everyday travel; review each day's routes, distance, stops and activity summary.
- Route history: view recorded routes on the 足迹地图 (footprint map), 足迹洞察 (Trail Insights) and 足迹星球 (Trail Planet); review recorded points, distance and visited cities.
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. No account is required. Route data stays on-device by default; optional iCloud backup uses the user's Apple CloudKit private database.
- [Official product page and download](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/)
- [English product page](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/timetrails/) · [English studio home](https://sxxw.site/en/)
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752662508): current availability and pricing are shown by the store.
- [Getting started](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/getting-started/) · [Guide in English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/timetrails/getting-started/) · [Support](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/support/) · [Support in English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/timetrails/support/) · [Privacy policy](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/privacy/)

## Apps

- [足迹-时光轨迹 (TimeTrails)](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/) · [English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/timetrails/): GPS route recorder for daily travel, walking, running, cycling, hiking and driving. "足迹洞察" (Trail Insights) summarizes recorded points, distance and cities; "足迹星球" (Trail Planet) displays routes on a 3D globe. Platforms: iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch. App Store ID: 6752662508; current availability and pricing: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752662508 . Route data stays on-device by default; iCloud private backup is optional.
- [纪念日 (Memoria)](https://sxxw.site/apps/memoria/) · [English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/memoria/): Countdown and reminder app for birthdays, anniversaries and important days, with home-screen widgets and on-the-day reminders. The iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch version (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760106574) is local-first with optional iCloud sync; the HarmonyOS version (Huawei AppGallery: https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/C6917613545100329502) is fully local — no network, no sync.
- [出行轨迹 TraceApp](https://sxxw.site/apps/traceapp/) · [English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/traceapp/): Local-first trip/route tracker showing path, mileage and pace. Platform: iPhone. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1634761411 . TraceApp users can migrate their data to the newer 足迹-时光轨迹 — guide: https://sxxw.site/migrate/ .
- [Harbor](https://sxxw.site/apps/harbor/) · [English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/harbor/): A WebDAV / HTTP video player for the user's own NAS or server, with folder browsing, a playback queue, resume and offline downloads. The latest 0.0.1 builds support standalone audio/video files, multi-select and WebDAV folder downloads; features depend on the installed build. Currently distributed through the [public TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/pmT8CR8S), not as a production App Store release. The public beta provides an iPhone / iPad build that also runs on compatible Apple silicon Macs; a native Mac installer is not publicly available. Test eligibility, expiry and device requirements are shown in TestFlight. Server passwords use the system Keychain; playback and downloads connect directly to the configured server. Harbor currently has no cross-device cloud sync.

## Languages and canonical pages

- The site navigation catalog contains 60 languages and regional variants. A locale URL does not by itself mean that all page content has been translated.
- Harbor product overviews are authored in Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French and Arabic: [中文](https://sxxw.site/apps/harbor/) · [English](https://sxxw.site/en/apps/harbor/) · [日本語](https://sxxw.site/ja/apps/harbor/) · [한국어](https://sxxw.site/ko/apps/harbor/) · [Français](https://sxxw.site/fr/apps/harbor/) · [العربية](https://sxxw.site/ar/apps/harbor/).
- Harbor support, privacy, terms and open-source documents are authored in Simplified Chinese and English. Other Harbor locale URLs reuse a supported body language and canonical destination. The published canonical URL and visible body identify the actual content version.
- Simplified Chinese pages use the site root. English pages use /en/. Untranslated privacy and terms copies for the other apps use the Chinese canonical document.
